title: Staged acceptance harness for graded degradations and traffic slicing (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank)
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a PRD and executable acceptance harness that validates staged rollouts for the hosted inference surface. Focus is on deterministic acceptance gates for chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank endpoints, plus an automated graded-degradation story (model downgrades, regional fallback, and capacity-sliced lanes). The harness should codify behavioral, performance, and quality thresholds for canary -> percentage rollout -> full launch, produce a checklist for runbook handoff, and surface actionable telemetry to the Console. This ticket coordinates PM requirements, test scenarios, and acceptance metrics; ENG will implement canary traffic-slicing and the QA automation hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Canary gating: for a 5% canary over 48 hours, all canary-specific metrics must meet thresholds before scaling to 25%
Performance SLOs: 95th percentile tail latency for chat generation <= 350ms in the region used for canary and p99 <= 650ms under canary load profile
Token-level cost: inferred per-token cost delta between main model and fallback model documented and under publishable threshold
Quality SLOs: embeddings cosine recall @k=10 >= 0.92 on the evaluation corpus used for launch validation
Rerank precision: reranker must maintain MAP >= 0.78 over the acceptance dataset and show no regression vs baseline
Graded degradation: automated policy applied when latency or error budget is breached to move traffic to defined fallback model variant within 60s
Telemetry: Console dashboard shows per-route latency, cost per 1k tokens, error budget burn, and a single 'acceptance' badge that flips to FAIL/PASS based on the above gates
Operational hooks: GitHub PR and canary runbook templates included and linked; on-call rotates notified and escalation steps listed
Security & compliance: KMS-integrated secrets used in canary environment and security review completed before 25% rollout
End-to-end tests: automated smoke tests for chat/completions/embeddings/rerank run pre-canary and post-canary with pass/fail recorded in CI
decisions: Use percentage-based traffic slicing via the router (not heavy-weight feature flags) to enable fast rollback
Default canary profile: 5% traffic for minimum 48 hours; 25% for 24 hours; final ramp to 100% on sustained pass
Fallback model family: use quantized smaller variant with identical API contract to preserve structured output
Acceptance dataset: combine synthetic prompt suite (500 prompts) + real anonymized customer prompt sample (200 prompts) for combined metrics
Instrumentation: require token-level cost and latency tagging at the SDK layer for all canary requests
review_feedback: ENG: request to relax p99 threshold for embeddings under cold-cache scenarios; recommended add separate cold-cache gating
Design: note to include UX copy for degraded responses in the Console alert UI
Security: must include KMS validation steps in runbook and add a checklist item for key rotation proof
